headline: Shibir leader Jisan Ahmed rescued in Cumilla after reported disappearance
summary: The assistant international affairs secretary of Bangladesh Islami Chhatra Shibir was found in an unwell condition in a field near Laksam Junction.
details: Jisan Ahmed, assistant international affairs secretary of Bangladesh Islami Chhatra Shibir’s central committee, was rescued from Cumilla’s Laksam upazila on Friday night.
Locals found him in an unwell condition in a field adjacent to Laksam Junction around 10:00 pm and informed the police.
He was first taken to a local hospital in Laksam and later shifted to Cumilla Medical College Hospital for better treatment.
Jisan's elder brother, Russel Ahmed Rafi, had filed police complaints after Jisan went missing from Daudkandi on Thursday night.
According to family members, Jisan was last active on WhatsApp at 8:29 pm on Thursday before his phone was switched off.
The rescue happened a day after he allegedly went missing after offering Isha prayers at the Daudkandi Model Mosque.
caption:
A missing Shibir leader has been found in an unwell condition in a field in Cumilla.

Jisan Ahmed, assistant international affairs secretary of Bangladesh Islami Chhatra Shibir’s central committee, was rescued from Cumilla’s Laksam upazila on Friday night.

Locals found him in an unwell condition in a field adjacent to Laksam Junction around 10:00 pm and informed the police.

He was first taken to a local hospital in Laksam and later shifted to Cumilla Medical College Hospital for better treatment.

Jisan's elder brother, Russel Ahmed Rafi, had filed police complaints after Jisan went missing from Daudkandi on Thursday night.

According to family members, Jisan was last active on WhatsApp at 8:29 pm on Thursday before his phone was switched off.

The rescue happened a day after he allegedly went missing after offering Isha prayers at the Daudkandi Model Mosque.

#Bangladesh #Cumilla #News #Shibir #Rescue

Source: The Daily Star, Somoy News, Jamuna TV, Prothom Alo

headline_marked: 6 arrested after [[attack on Coast Guard station]] in Mongla
headline: 6 arrested after attack on Coast Guard station in Mongla
summary: Tensions remain high in the area following the incident; security forces have detained six individuals in connection with the attack.
details: A Coast Guard station in Mongla was targeted in an attack, leading to significant tension in the locality.
Following the incident, security forces conducted an operation and have arrested six people suspected of involvement in the attack.
The situation in Mongla remains tense as authorities continue their investigation into the motive and the scale of the attack.
Local administration and security forces are monitoring the situation closely to prevent further unrest.
caption:
Six people have been arrested following an attack on a Coast Guard station in Mongla.

A Coast Guard station in Mongla was targeted in an attack, leading to significant tension in the locality.

Following the incident, security forces conducted an operation and have arrested six people suspected of involvement in the attack.

The situation in Mongla remains tense as authorities continue their investigation into the motive and the scale of the attack.

Local administration and security forces are monitoring the situation closely to prevent further unrest.
